notes.text: C. Fleury has been a scratch for the last 4 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
V. Dunn has started killing penalties: on the ice for 31% of the team’s shorthanded time in 7 games, up from 2% last season.
Y. Gourde is on the injured non-roster list (hip surgery) and has not played this season. He is a top-six forward. I. Mikheyev has taken his spot beside Z. Girgensons and P. Holmberg.
J. Carlson is no longer killing penalties: 0% of the team’s shorthanded time in 6 games, down from 47% with his old team last season.

faceoff.text: A. Cirelli is sent out to take power-play faceoffs, then changes. He has taken 38% of the team’s power-play draws but stays on for about 26 seconds at a time, against 66 for the regulars, and is most often replaced by B. Hagel (9 of 13 changes).

TBL.head: The Lightning should be in control
TBL.body: Tampa Bay has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. The Kraken’s best way in is keeping dangerous shots away.

SEA.head: The Lightning should be favored
SEA.body: Tampa Bay has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. The Kraken’s best hope is keeping dangerous shots away, plus a big night in goal.
